frontier_selector.why: The evidence of SARS-CoV-2 nasopharyngeal swab PCR positivity and high SARS-CoV-2 spike protein antibodies, along with the initial low LVEF that improved, decided it.

support_spans: SARS-CoV-2 nasopharyngeal swab PCR: Ct of 29
Chest radiograph: small left upper lobe infiltrate
Echocardiogram: Initial LVEF 18%, improved to 30% several hours later
contradict_spans: Cardiac MRI: EF 50%, no signs of infiltrative process, myocarditis, or ischemic changes
Genetic screening: negative for mutations predisposing to arrhythmias
